subject.title: fix(cron): allow timeoutSeconds: 0 for no-timeout mode

question: Should maintainers keep this old-base contributor PR as the active fix candidate, or close it and replace it with a rebased, proven fix for the linked Control UI bug?
rationale: The underlying bug remains valid, but the branch is conflicting, unproven, and has had no contributor commits since March 9, 2026, so cleanup requires a human PR-lifecycle choice rather than a deterministic close reason.

options.title: Close And Replace
options.body: Close the stale conflicting PR and use the linked issue as the canonical source for a narrow rebased fix with proof.

options.title: Request Rebase And Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open only if the contributor is expected to port it to the current module, update tests/copy, and add real behavior proof.

options.title: Leave As Candidate
options.body: Leave this PR open as the linked candidate despite the conflict and proof gap, accepting that it is not merge-ready today.

recommendation.title: Close And Replace
recommendation.body: Close the stale conflicting PR and use the linked issue as the canonical source for a narrow rebased fix with proof.
